Nintendo Switch is a hybrid video game console.
First released worldwide in March 2017 and discontinued in 2027.
Made by Nintendo.
It launched at $299.99 in the US.
About 156.6 million units were sold.
It followed the Wii U and was succeeded by the Nintendo Switch 2.
Processors include the NVIDIA Tegra X1.
